follow-up time: Median of 10.7 years (IQR: 6.6-15.4) after transplant for females
cohort: 62,988 pediatric patients (<18 years old at first transplantation) who received HCT between 1995 and 2016 and were registered in the European Society for Blood and Marrow Transplantation (EBMT) registry
finding: This study found that conception was possible, both naturally and with assisted reproduction, for patients who underwent HCT in childhood or adolescence, even after myeloablative conditioning regimens.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery was more common in women who had received a myeloablative regimen.
birth_weight: 43/46 (93%) of infants born to females in the study had normal birthweight.
